note: Work: Law No. 6 of 2010 on Labour in the Private Sector, Articles 19 and 20, read in a print of the Public Authority for Manpower's online text (printed 16 June 2017) that Alkarama publishes, since the Government's own PDF on e.gov.kw refused this client (403) and the Authority's site wasn't reached: employing anyone under 15 (Gregorian years) is prohibited, and juveniles of 15 to 18 may be employed with the Ministry's permission on conditions (no hazardous or unhealthy work, among others). The Law makes no exception for performers, so a performer under 15 is held as barred (a reading, not the law's word). The PDF's Arabic is in presentation-form characters, quoted exactly as its text layer gives them. Article 27 gives a person of 15 capacity to make an employment contract, which the form doesn't hold. Majority: not read; the Civil Code (Law No. 67 of 1980) wasn't reached. Service: not read; Law No. 20 of 2015 on Military National Service (amended by Decree-Law No. 9 of 2026, per the press) wasn't reached: the National Service Authority's site (kns.gov.kw) didn't answer, and the Ministry of Defence's returned a server error.
